paper_citation: Y. Yang, Y.A. Chang, Thermodynamic modeling of the Mo–Si–B system, Intermetallics 13, 121-128 (2005).
quote: Based on the cooling curves of Mo0.625Si0.125B0.25 and Mo0.72Si0.1B0.18, Schneibel et al. [12] estimated that the melting temperature of T2 is about 2400 K and the final freezing of the alloys in the Mo-rich region is about 2200 K.
